pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and roughly rhomboidal dark regions with smooth, high-width pixel gradients at the edges due to focal blur. Patch spatial area is dominant relative to the surrounding matrix.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate intersections. Pathway thickness is consistent across the visible flank.
